summary_en: The study tests repotrectinib (TPX-0005) in people with advanced solid tumors that have an ALK, ROS1, or NTRK1-3 gene rearrangement. Repotrectinib is given by mouth as oral capsules, and how long or how often it is taken is not stated. The Phase 2 part measures the confirmed overall response rate, as assessed by blinded independent central review.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa repotrectinib (TPX-0005) en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una reordenación de los genes ALK, ROS1 o NTRK1-3. Repotrectinib se administra por vía oral en forma de cápsulas, y la duración o la frecuencia del tratamiento no se indican. La parte de fase 2 mide la tasa de respuesta global confirmada, evaluada por una revisión central independiente y ciega.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a documented ROS1 or NTRK1-3 gene fusion
Age 12 or older; ages 12 to 17 need parent or guardian assent
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST 1.1, confirmed before enrollment
Life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Taking part in another therapeutic clinical trial at the same time
Symptomatic brain metastases or leptomeningeal involvement
Clinically significant heart disease within 6 months, or abnormal QTc
Peripheral neuropathy of grade 2 or higher, or grade 3 to 4 interstitial lung disease
